name: Amethyst Phial
summary: In Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage entrusts travelers with the Amethyst Phial. They take it to the Oracle Glade and gather water from the moonwell beneath the Oracle Tree.

sections.title: Vessel of Sacred Waters
sections.body:
Corithras Moonrage gives travelers on Teldrassil the Amethyst Phial. It is the final vessel in the Crown of the Earth pilgrimage. They carry it to the Oracle Glade in the far northwest of the boughs.

Beneath the Oracle Tree’s ancient canopy lies the island’s first and most potent moonwell. Travelers dip the phial into its radiant waters to gather the essence of Elune’s grace. Druids and priestesses study and tend the World Tree’s unpredictable growth with that water.

sections.title: A Burden of Unblessed Growth
sections.body:
Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm guided the raising of Teldrassil, but the Dragon Aspects refused to bless it. They considered the act arrogant. As a consequence, corruption troubles the boughs and the kaldorei remain mortal.

Filling the Amethyst Phial is both a spiritual rite and an ongoing survey. Researchers in Dolanaar scrutinize the purity of Teldrassil’s sacred waters.

faq.q: What is the Amethyst Phial used for?
aliases: what do i do with amethyst phial
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage gives you the phial to gather water from Teldrassil’s first and most potent moonwell, beneath the Oracle Tree in the Oracle Glade.

faq.q: Where do I fill the Amethyst Phial?
faq.answer: Fill the phial at the moonwell far northwest of Dolanaar, north of the entrance to Darnassus, in the Oracle Glade.

faq.q: Why is the water from the Oracle Glade so important?
faq.answer: The moonwell beneath the Oracle Tree is considered the first and most potent well on the World Tree. Its waters carry the essence of Elune and help researchers monitor Teldrassil’s spiritual and physical health.

faq.q: Who sends you to use this phial?
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage, a night elf druid in Dolanaar, gives you the phial for a ritual meant to understand Teldrassil’s troubled growth.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you take on a solemn duty when you fill the phial and confront the flaws in Teldrassil’s unblessed creation.
As a druid, you use the phial to monitor the World Tree’s vital energies and creeping corruption.

attribution: Teldrassil: The Burden of the Kaldorei
